context: Crossfilter dashboard with three linked panels: horizontal bar chart (revenue by category), multi-line time series (monthly revenue), and scatter plot (satisfaction vs volume), with reduced-motion accessibility support.
first_impression: Structurally honest crossfilter dashboard with data-driven domains and key functions throughout, let down by missing-data-as-zero treatment in the line chart.
what_works: Bar and line Y-axes both start at zero with data-driven domains (d3.max from full dataset); key functions (d => d.cat, d => d.id) are present in all three charts preventing join corruption on filter updates.
what_doesnt: Line chart fills missing month/category combos with 0 via `|| 0` instead of using line.defined(), implying false zero revenue rather than absent data; scatter X/Y domains are fixed at page-load extent and never reflect the filtered subset, which is acceptable but means shift robustness is partially hardcoded to the initial data range.
